title: Fig Builds a Soft Bed
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 76-sound stage (ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.text: Fig wants a soft spot to rest.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking around a leafy corner for somewhere comfy to rest.
Fig the caterpillar pulling a wide soft green leaf into place.
Fig the caterpillar gathering a small tuft of soft white plant fluff.

pages.text: Fig sets the fluff on the moss.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pressing the soft fluff down onto the green leaf.
Fig the caterpillar climbing up onto the leaf and fluff.
Fig the caterpillar lying flat on the leaf, looking unimpressed.

pages.text: Fig sets a soft twig for a lift.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar tucking a small soft twig underneath one edge of the leaf.

pages.text: Now it is soft and not flat.
pages.illustration: The little leaf bed now gently raised on one side by the twig.

pages.text: Fig curls up on the best soft bed.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep on his new soft leaf bed.
